final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT district_id AS d, COUNT(*) AS c FROM account GROUP BY district_id), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS t FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.d AS d, s1.c AS c, CAST(s1.c AS REAL) / s2.t AS r FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.t IS NOT NULL AND s2.t <> 0), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS a FROM s3) SELECT s3.d, s3.c, s3.r, s3.r - s4.a AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.a IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
